label: Приказ
description: A 10-sentence usage card for приказ (order, command).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Приказ' is the masculine nominative as the predicate noun. 'Строгий' is the agreeing adjective, and 'был' is the past copula.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Приказ' is the accusative direct object of 'отдал'; this inanimate masculine noun matches the nominative. 'Командир' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after verb. 'Приказа' is the genitive required by 'ждём'. 'Начальника' is itself genitive showing whose order it is.
Strategic focus: Dative after verb. 'Приказу' is the dative required by 'подчинились' meaning to obey. 'Солдаты' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after adjective. 'Приказом' is instrumental governed by 'недоволен'. 'Этим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Приказе' is the prepositional form after 'в' to mark what is written inside. 'Ясно' adds the manner.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Приказу' is the dative after 'по' to mean according to the order. A common official formula.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Приказ' is nominative as the subject of 'вступил'. 'В силу' is a set accusative phrase meaning into force.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Приказы' is the accusative plural object of 'подписал', matching the nominative plural. 'Новые' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Приказах' is the prepositional plural after 'в' to mark location. 'Много ошибок' uses the genitive plural of quantity.
